description: GDPR contains Art.5 — the seven core data processing principles
GDPR contains Art.6 — lawful bases for processing personal data
GDPR contains Art.9 — prohibition and conditions for special category data
GDPR contains Art.13 — transparency obligations at data collection
GDPR contains Art.17 — right to erasure

GDPR contains Art.25 — data protection by design and default
GDPR contains Art.28 — data processing agreements with processors
GDPR contains Art.30 — records of processing activities (ROPA)
GDPR contains Art.32 — security of processing obligations
GDPR contains Art.33 — 72-hour breach notification to supervisory authority
GDPR contains Art.35 — DPIA requirement for high-risk processing
GDPR contains Art.37 — mandatory DPO appointment
GDPR contains Art.46 — appropriate safeguards for third-country transfers

AI Act contains Art.6 — high-risk AI classification criteria

AI Act contains Art.10 — data governance requirements for high-risk AI
AI Act contains Art.11 — technical documentation obligations
AI Act contains Art.13 — transparency and logging for high-risk AI
AI Act contains Art.14 — human oversight of high-risk AI

Lawfulness principle (Art.5(1)(a)) requires a lawful basis to be identified under Art.6
Accountability principle (Art.5(2)) is demonstrated through ROPA records (Art.30)
Principles (storage limitation, security) trigger DPIA requirement when high-risk processing planned
Processing special categories must satisfy both Art.6 lawful basis AND Art.9 conditions
Right to erasure (Art.17) is limited where processing is based on legal obligation (Art.6(1)(c)) — AML records cannot be erased
GDPR Art.22 right against automated decisions is reinforced by AI Act Art.14 human oversight requirement for high-risk AI
GDPR privacy by design (Art.25) parallels AI Act data governance (Art.10) — both require built-in protections
GDPR Art.28 DPA requirements govern all data processor relationships
Security measures (Art.32) determine severity of breaches and notification need (Art.33)
DPIA must be consulted with DPO (Art.35(2)) before being conducted
DPO must be consulted on DPIA and informs when to conduct prior supervisory authority consultation
AI Act Art.6 high-risk classification uses Annex III list of high-risk AI areas
Risk management system (Art.9) applies to all AI systems classified as high-risk per Art.6
Data governance requirements (Art.10) apply to high-risk AI systems
Technical documentation (Art.11) is the basis for conformity assessment (Art.43)
Transparency and logging (Art.13) enables effective human oversight (Art.14)
Conformity assessment (Art.43) must be completed before registration (Art.51)
Art.53 GPAI obligations are the base; Art.55 adds additional requirements for systemic risk models
AI Act Art.26 deployer obligations include DPIA where GDPR applies — deployers must check GDPR DPIA need
AI providers are responsible for establishing the risk management system required by Art.9
AI providers are responsible for technical documentation under Art.11
AI providers are responsible for conformity assessment under Art.43
AI deployers are subject to the obligations in AI Act Art.26
AI deployers in scope (public bodies, credit scoring, insurance) must conduct FRIA under Art.26(9)
GPAI models are subject to Art.53 obligations
GPAI models with systemic risk (≥10^25 FLOPs) are additionally subject to Art.55
Data controller is accountable for compliance with all GDPR Art.5 principles
Data controller must maintain ROPA under Art.30
Data controller must conduct DPIA for high-risk processing under Art.35
Data processor is governed by the DPA under Art.28
Data processor is also responsible for security of processing under Art.32
DPIA Process implements the GDPR Art.35 requirement
SAR Process handles erasure requests under Art.17
Data Breach Management Process implements Art.33 notification within 72 hours
EDPB ensures consistent application of GDPR across Member States
National DPAs enforce GDPR in their Member State
National DPAs act as market surveillance authorities for AI Act for most high-risk AI
EU AI Office oversees GPAI model compliance with Art.53 obligations
EU AI Office enforces GPAI systemic risk obligations under Art.55
GDPR × AI Act cross-reference documents overlapping obligations
GDPR × AI Act cross-reference documents overlapping obligations
GDPR × AMLR cross-reference documents tensions between AML obligations and data protection
GDPR × DORA cross-reference documents overlapping security and incident reporting obligations
